name: Brazilian Portuguese Multi-Competency Essay Benchmark
description: A benchmark dataset of narrative student essays in Brazilian Portuguese annotated with multi-competency grades for automatic essay scoring.
reputation: A specialized resource for Brazilian Portuguese automated essay scoring research with modest adoption in regional NLP communities.
notes: Language-specific (Brazilian Portuguese); multi-competency labels can cause class imbalance; dataset size may be modest; primarily for AES research (not an LLM benchmark).
